versions.changelog:
No user-visible changes in this version.  
- No files were changed between versions 1.0.0 and 1.0.1.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same.

Initial release — analyze open-source projects by AI/Agent-engineer job-market competency framework.

- Enables detailed, code-based analysis of open-source projects aligned with skills needed for AI Agent/LLM engineering and architecture roles.
- Uses a competency framework to assess project strengths across Agent design, multi-agent collaboration, RAG systems, LLM usage, architecture, security, observability, evaluation, and AI-driven development.
- Reports focus on concrete code examples, engineering decisions, and comparisons to industry practices.
- Promotes learning from real-world implementations mapped to job requirements for roles from junior developer to AI architect.
